title: Disease Control & Prevention
content:
Our well trained Disease Control Professionals protect the health and safety of the population through Disease Surveillance and Response Systems, preparedness for emerging and re-emerging health threats, events or outbreaks, health promotion, prevention and control of communicable and non-communicable diseases, including public health workforce development and training.

It encompasses the use of health technologies to reduce incidence and prevalence of communicable and non-communicable diseases, interruption of disease transmission through designing and implementation of Public Health Interventional programmes to protect human and environment in accordance with standard public health concept in Ghana.

Our goal is to control, eliminate, eradicate and manage emergence and re-emergence of health threats, events or communicable and non-communicable diseases, including disease or events under the International Health Regulation 2005. Categories;

  • Epidemiologist
  • Public Health Officers (Disease Control)
  • Disease Control Officer
  • Disease Control Technical Officer
  • Disease Control Technical Assistant (Field Technician)

title: Health Information Management
content:
These are healthcare professionals trained in public health and Information management and are involved in the practice of acquiring, analyzing and protecting digital and traditional medical information, Public health information, vital to providing quality patient care and protecting the population at all levels of the health care structure of Ghana.

Their primary duty involves the provision of Reliable and timely health information as an essential foundation of public health action and health systems strengthening, both in Ghana and internationally. Health information provides the underpinnings for decision-making in the area of data generation, compilation, analysis and synthesis, and communication and use. Means the practice involving the reception, creation, storage and analysis of health information so created and reporting and research; and includes health records practice, anatomy and physiology, disease classification and medical terminology competence, hospital activity analysis, initiation of death audits in all health facilities public and private and Information & communication technology (ICT) for health; or any other related subject as may be approved by the council.

  • Health Information Officer.
  • Health Information Technical Officer.
  • Health Information Assistant.

title: Nutrition
content:
Nutrition is the science concerned with Investigate the metabolic and physiological responses of the body to diet with advances in the fields of food science, biochemistry, molecular biology, genetics and social sciences. The study of human nutrition is increase concerned with metabolism and metabolic pathways: the sequences of biochemical steps through which substance in living things change from one form to another.

  • Nutrition Technical Officers.
